title: Easy-CD folders
description: Open the folders you pinned or visited lately with easy-cd (ecd) in a terminal, without typing a path. Its page searches them as you type.
examples: Type pil: your pinned ~/code/pilot first, then recent folders matching it; Return opens a terminal there
Cmd+K on a folder: open it in Finder or copy its path
